title: rhamnus purshiana var. tomentella
intro: Rhamnus purshiana var. tomentella, commonly known as Cascara Sagrada, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the Pacific Northwest region of North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for centuries to support digestive health, and its health benefits include treating constipation, diarrhea, and irritable bowel syndrome. The therapeutic actions of Cascara Sagrada include stimulating bowel movements, increasing gut motility, and reducing inflammation in the gastrointestinal tract. The bioactive constituents of Cascara Sagrada include anthraquinones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
